highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of York, founded in 1963, is a dynamic and research-driven university located in one of the UK's most historic and beautiful cities. It’s a member of Russell Group’s research-intensive universities in the UK.

The university is an excellent space for international students to thrive and learn together. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and distance education programs.

highlights.title: Rankings
highlights.value:
World rankings for the University of York

Take a look at how the University of York is ranked and recognised around the world.

World rankings for the University of York
Take a look at how the University of York is ranked and recognised around the world.

Complete University Guide Ranking
According to the Complete University Guide, the University of York stands at #17 out of 130 universities for 2025. It was ranked #9 for research, #68 for student satisfaction, #28 for student-staff ratio and 14 subjects ranked in the top #10.

The Good University Guide
According to the Good University Guide 2025 by The Times and Sunday Times, which ranks Britain universities based on entry requirements, student satisfaction and environmental sustainability, the University of York ranks #17 and 11 of its subjects rank in the top 10.

QS Ranking
The QS Ranking for the University in 2025 is #169, with 7 of its subjects ranking in the top 100 in the world. It also ranked #79 in the world for Arts & Humanities. The university also ranks #12 in the UK and #34 globally (top 2%) in the QS Sustainability Rankings 2025.

Times Higher Education Ranking
Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings marked in #146 in 2025. According to THE, it’s ranked #54 in the world for arts and humanities, top 175 for life sciences and top 150 for social sciences. THE also launched Interdisciplinary Science Rankings (ISR) in 2025, where the University of York ranked #51.

Guardian University Guide
The Guardian University Guide 2025 ranked it #25 based on factors such as student satisfaction, graduate outcomes, spend per student and more.

US News & World Report Ranking
The US News & World Report launched its 2025 rankings where the University of York came
#245 in Best Global Universities, #96 in Best Global Universities in Europe and #25 in Best Global Universities in the United Kingdom. In terms of subject rankings, it came #87 in Arts and Humanities, #71 in Meteorology and Atmospheric Sciences.

ARWU
According to the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) 2024, the University of York falls in the 301-400 band.

TEF Rating

The university received an overall rating of Gold from the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) in 2023. 

Culture of inclusion
Athena Swan recognised the university’s commitment towards gender equality with a bronze institutional award and 22 departmental awards.

highlights.title: Requirements
highlights.value:
Entry requirements

You’ll be expected to have a good academic profile, English language proficiency and certain additional requirements to study at the University of York. Be it law, maths, MBA, engineering or arts, these requirements will vary depending on your study level and your country of residence. For more details on the overall entry requirements, see below. You can also sign up with us and a dedicated UK expert from our team will get in touch with you.

highlights.title: Fee
highlights.value:
Tuition Fee

The cost of studies for international students at the University of York can come to anywhere between GBP 7000 to GBP 37,000 per year, depending on the study level and program selected.

highlights.title: Admission Details
highlights.value:
Admissions

If you’re looking to apply to the University of York, you’ve made an excellent choice. The deadline for the upcoming intake is Jul 31, 2025. The University is open for admissions and here’s what you’ll need to do, to apply:

  • Select a course that best suits your interests and qualifications, and apply for it
  • Upload all your documents (SOP, LOR, Passport, Marksheets, and more) and get the documents verified
  • Use our AI-powered search system, Genie, to check if your admission chances are high
  • Start your application by filling in the required fields
  • Pay the application fee, if applicable
  • Wait for the university to respond (this will take a few weeks)
  • Meet the conditions of the offer letter
  • Pay the deposit fee (if you’re looking for financial assistance, the Funds feature on our app can help you out)
  • Find a suitable accommodation in York on campus or find ones nearby using the Stays feature on our app
  • Book your tickets and get ready for a brand-new experience

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
Student life

York offers a rich and diverse student life. With over 200 clubs and societies, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to get involved in everything from sports to volunteering.

Student well-being is also a big priority at York. The university’s wellbeing services include mental health support, counselling, and financial advice. Plus, the campus is home to many student-led initiatives, events, and wellness programs to help you.

Grading system

The University of York’s grading system is marked from 1-100. When you reach the university, a course coordinator will run you through the marking system for your projects.

University of York’s Student Union

The University also has a friendly and approachable Students’ Union that can help you with events, clubs, resources to manage costs, campus tours and more.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Student accommodations

Student accommodation provided by the University of York

The University of York offers a range of on-campus accommodation options, all of which are within easy reach of the campus. It offers single-occupancy accommodation, self-catered and catered ones. You also have stay options for families.

Off-campus accommodation

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature! You’ll find a range of stay options that are verified, and you’ll get a dedicated expert to help you through the entire process.

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library

There’s something for every kind of student in the library! It offers access to thousands of books, journals, and online resources.

University of York Library Search

To easily search for what’s available in the library, you can check out the library catalogue – YorSearch.

The library is a modern, spacious space with quiet study zones, group work areas, and computer facilities. If you wish to book a study space in the library, you can head here.

What is the University of York Library opening time?

The main library’s opening times are 8 AM to midnight, all through the week. During the Common Assessment Periods (CAP) which takes place at the end of the semester, the library is open 24x7.

Sports

The university has excellent sports facilities, including the York Sport Village, a multi-million-pound complex with an Olympic-sized swimming pool, a state-of-the-art gym, and various indoor sports halls. York also has a range of sports clubs and fitness programs for all abilities.

If you prefer outdoor sports, the campus features football and rugby pitches, tennis courts, and running tracks. York is also home to several student sports teams, from rowing to netball.

Laboratory

York’s labs feature modern facilities for scientific or engineering fields. The University also has dedicated labs for computer science, environmental sciences, and healthcare programs, and you’ll be learning in some of the best research environments in the UK.

Cafeteria

On campus, you’ll find several cafés, restaurants, and food courts. The University also offers a variety of healthy and sustainable food options, including vegan and vegetarian dishes.
